title: Nutty Creamy Filipino Steak Sisig
description: A show-off Filipino dish featuring a tender fillet of steak, wrapped in a crispy ssam and topped with a nutty and creamy sauce.

ingredients.name: Ribeye or New York strip steak

instructions: Heat peanut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the steak for 2-3 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness. Let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
In the same skillet, add more oil if necessary and sauté the onion and chili peppers until they are softened.
Add the garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the fish sauce, lime juice, soy sauce, and sesame oil to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the sliced steak back into the skillet and toss it with the sauce.
Add the peanut butter and sugar-free ketchup to the skillet and stir to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt and black pepper.
To assemble the sisig, place a few slices of the steak onto a ssam leaf, followed by a spoonful of the sauce and some green onions.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients and serve immediately.
To make the sauce creamier, you can add a little bit of heavy cream or sour cream.
You can also add some chopped cilantro or scallions on top of the sisig for extra flavor and color.
